description: Live lowest listing prices for CS2 items on up to 12 marketplaces (YouPin898, BUFF163, C5Game, EcoSteam, SkinBaron, Skinport, CSFloat, LIS-SKINS, DMarket, ShadowPay, Waxpeer, Market.CSGO) plus the Steam Community Market best ask/bid. Refreshed about every 5 minutes. Prices are in each market's own currency (CNY, EUR or USD) with an approximate USD value for comparison, plus listing counts and the cheapest market. Doppler / Gamma Doppler names without a phase return every phase separately. Without an API key (preview): one item per call, 5 calls per day, prices from a snapshot up to 6 hours old.
